description: Get the transfer authorization (EPP) code for a domain. This code is needed to transfer the domain to another registrar. Can optionally generate a new code and unlock the domain for transfer.

domain.description: Domain name to get the auth code for

new_code.description: Generate a new authorization code instead of returning the existing one

unlock_for_transfer.description: Automatically unlock the domain for transfer when retrieving the code

name: get_auth_code
